VERSIONS.heading: Software Release: GC 4.6.0
subHeadings: Release Notes - General Commons – Version GC FE Version: 4.6.0

list: Temporary Maintenance Banner - A new Temporary Maintenance feature designed to improve user communication when specific pages are undergoing short-term maintenance. This feature enables the display of a banner at the top of the GC portal, notifying users that a particular page is temporarily unavailable.
Memgraph Node Query Counts: Updated and corrected the node query count logic to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of query results.
Library Source Molecule – Metagenomic: updated to reflect that existing functionality continues to work as expected with the new Metagenomic data type addition.

VERSIONS.heading: Software Release: GC 4.2.0
subHeadings: Release Notes - General Commons – Version GC FE Version: 4.2.0

list: Migration to Memgraph Database - We've migrated our data backend to Memgraph, enhancing performance, scalability, and support for advanced graph queries.
CRDC Helpdesk Footer Addition - A direct link to the CRDC Helpdesk has been added in the website footer for improved user support access.
Participant Dropdown Tooltip - Tooltips are now available in the participant dropdown for clearer context and easier navigation.
Enhanced Search Capabilities - You can now search within the General Commons by: PHS Accessions, Study Name, File Type
GC Documentation (via the “About” section) – GC User Guide and GC API Query Documentation
Improved Programs Listing Page - The Programs page layout has been optimized to reduce white space, providing cleaner and more efficient user experience.
Submission Request Redirect - Fixed an issue when clicking on a submission request would erroneously scroll the page to the footer.
Footer External Links Behavior - External links in the “More Information” section of the footer now open in the same new tab, as expected.
Global Search Footer Obstruction - Corrected a problem where search results were being partially obscured by the footer.
Duplicate ‘X’ Icons in Global Search Bar - Removed redundant close (X) icons from the Global Search Bar for a more streamlined UI.
GC Home Page URL Fix - The GC Home Page URL has been updated to include the missing suffix “/home”, ensuring correct navigation.
